uzo.purpose: Shows the name or a short hint of a control while it is hovered or focused.

instead.kialo: What a person needs to act stands visibly as text — under a field as the kampo's help, elsewhere as running text — because whoever does not hover or focus never sees a tooltip, and on touch there is no hovering.
A layer a person operates — a link, a field, a button in it — is a popover, because a tooltip vanishes when the pointer leaves and takes no focus; the sxvebilo stays and holds the focus.

boundary.kialo: A konsileto on a disabled control is not reached by keyboard — because the disabled Ero says its reason itself: slot disabled-reason, shown in its own konsileto (Spec 029 ②b-1 M-1).

with.kialo: A button that shows only an icon carries its name as a tooltip, because whoever sees only a picture needs the word visibly too; the tooltip's text is the button's label, heard once.
An icon that carries meaning may show its name on hover, because the word confirms what the sign says; a decorative icon has no tooltip, it says nothing.

case.de: Die Person braucht den Text, um handeln zu können.
case.en: The person needs the text in order to act.

case.de: In der Ebene liegt etwas zum Bedienen, ein Verweis, ein Feld oder eine Schaltfläche.
case.en: The layer holds something to operate, a link, a field or a button.

do.de: Halte den Text kurz: ein Name oder ein kurzer Hinweis.
do.en: Keep the text short: a name or a brief hint.

do.de: Gib einer Schaltfläche, die nur ein Symbol zeigt, einen Tooltip mit ihrem Namen.
do.en: Give a button that shows only an icon a tooltip with its name.

do.de: Verbinde den Tooltip über for mit dem Element, das er beschreibt.
do.en: Tie the tooltip with for to the element it describes.

dont.de: Wichtige Angaben nur im Tooltip zeigen, denn auf Touch-Geräten erscheint er nicht.
dont.en: Show important information only in the tooltip, because on touch devices it does not appear.

dont.de: Einen Tooltip an ein deaktiviertes Element hängen; dessen Grund steht im eigenen Slot disabled-reason.
dont.en: Attach a tooltip to a disabled element; its reason belongs in its own slot disabled-reason.

action.de: Blendet den Tooltip aus; der Fokus bleibt auf dem Element, das er beschreibt.
action.en: Hides the tooltip; the focus stays on the element it describes.
